name: 水の波紋
code: const n = Math.floor(p.a / 6.29 * 4), u = t * .2 * sp + n * .25 + p.k * .03, ph = u - Math.floor(u), R = ph * Math.min(W, H) * .45 + 6, g = p.a * 13 + p.k * 50; p.vx = p.vx * .8 + (f.x + Math.cos(g) * R - p.x) * .08; p.vy = p.vy * .8 + (f.y + Math.sin(g) * R - p.y) * .08;
